name: MathTool
label: Math
description: Perform math calculations: basic arithmetic (add, subtract, multiply, divide) and statistical operations (avg, sum, min, max, median, std) on numbers and arrays.

fields.label: Value / Array
fields.description: For statistical operations (avg, sum, etc): provide an array of numbers. For binary operations (add, multiply, etc): provide the left operand number.

fields.label: Operator
fields.description: Mathematical operation: arithmetic (add/subtract/multiply/divide) needs two operands; statistical (avg/sum/min/max/count/median/std) operates on array.

fields.label: Right Operand
fields.description: Second number for arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide). Not used for statistical operations.
